scope: Opt-in parity and pretrained checks using artifacts already present on this host; this does not cover TensorFlow, ONNX Runtime, or opensr-test.

environment.execution: CUDA checks used escalated execution; CPU checks used the project .venv

checks.details: Strict v1 state load, persisted schedule, and one-step DDIM shape/nodata check passed.
Native contracts, source-reader/conversion equality, and public cached checkpoint path passed; CUDA and TensorFlow checks were skipped.
Native varied-routing parity against the frozen reference passed exactly for seeds 0, 1, and 2.
CPU and CUDA release artifact shape/finite-output checks passed.
Converted artifacts are present, but onnxruntime is not installed; no dependency was downloaded.

limitations: LDSR frozen upstream parity requires the separate /work/code/opensr-model checkout and its research dependencies.
Evoland ONNX parity remains unrun until onnxruntime is available.
This report contains no real opensr-test end-to-end result.
